data.title: ZATCA Calls on Businesses to Submit October VAT Returns by November 30
data.content: Riyadh, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) has called on businesses subject to Value Added Tax (VAT) with annual supplies of goods and services exceeding SAR40 million to submit their VAT returns for October by November 30, 2026. ZATCA urged businesses to submit their returns and settle their payments promptly through the ZATCA smartphone application to avoid late-filing penalties ranging from 5% to 25% of the tax amount that should have been declared. For further information about VAT, businesses can contact ZATCA through its 24/7 unified call center at 19993, the "Ask ZATCA" account on X (@Zatca_Care), or by email at info@zatca.gov.sa. Inquiries can also be submitted through the live chat service on the authority's website: ‏zatca.gov.sa VAT is an indirect tax imposed in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia on most goods and services purchased and sold by businesses, with certain exceptions. -- SPA 17:48 Local Time 14:48 GMT 0025
